title: 第1350章 尘埃落定第1349章 怎么办
content_zh:
不知道哪里冒出来的人，竟然能压着那位，像神一样的男人打，只是大家还来不及吃瓜，就被双方大打出手而感到震惊。
对于打斗的双方来说，那些高楼大厦、各种建筑，就像是沙子堆砌的一样，一碰就碎了一地。
亨特只能下令，所有还能正常活动的圣教军，全力救援，被双方打斗而波及到的市民！
不过最后的结果也并不理想，大家都只能就近躲进了庇护所。
因为双方打斗迸发的能量，实在是太过于庞大。
一开始还好，只要不是倒霉被撞到，问题不大，后面地面根本没办法待，其中一人的能量太过于强大，好似可以融化周围一切的物质，地面都在不断的下沉。
有的圣教军，因为带着人来不及躲避，被那股无形的能量场笼罩，也不过三五秒也要化作灰灰。
哪怕圣教军都拥有自己的信仰，如此震撼人心的打斗场景，让大家心中不由自主的，生出了将自家信仰的神只，与打斗的双方拿来做起了比较。
当然，也有很多圣教军，死于双方的交战。
……
“好了！警戒解除了，大家都出去吧。”克劳.苏说道。
刚刚ai手环上的区域灾害，公告已经解除了，克劳.苏就指挥大家离开地下庇护所，沉默的等待最是难熬。
拉菲.伊维里欧斯，抢先一步领着人，离开了庇护所，进了升降机。
“啊～拉菲殿下！”苏梅拉惊呼道。
苏梅拉是陪着拉菲公主，第一批到达地面的人，她就站在升降机的门口，一开门就看见了眼前地下室，变了样子。
原本豪华的地下室，如今布满了尘土碎屑，这地下室的入口，大门已经不见踪影。
也不是大门没了，而是地下室的上层建筑整体没了。
问题这还不是让她惊讶的！
让苏梅拉发出惊叫的，是地下室入口，投进来的场景！
这地下室是哪里？

不说是苏府的核心区域，也至少是苏府之内吧？
外面可是苏府的别院，如今竟然能直接看到天空！！！
“别急！我们先出去看看！”拉菲.伊维里欧斯说道。
随即苏梅拉扶着拉菲公主，缓缓走上了楼梯，这时候大家都发现脚下，还有一层厚厚的粉末，踩上去还会陷下去软软的。
越到入口处就越厚，到上面几个台阶的时候，已经看不到原本的楼梯了。
不知道这是什么东西，沙土应该不可能有这么多才对？
……
众人集体失声！
眼前一眼望去，只有远处的季风学院，还有更远处的几栋熟知的建筑，还残存在这大地之上，其余的只剩下沙土，还有更远处，仅能够看到一点轮廓的黑山山脉！
如果不是拉菲公主，拥有传奇职业者的身体，还能看清楚远处的季风学院，她都要以为自己，现在自己身处异地了！
周围的一切人造建筑、地貌，仿佛被一只看不见的大手抹去了，只余下脚下细细的沙土。
“请让一下，拉菲.伊维里欧斯。”扎克利.苏说道。
克劳.苏与扎克利.苏等人，被拉菲公主一群人，堵在了出口，克劳.苏与拉菲公主撕破了脸皮，不愿意跟她多说什么，所以由扎克利开的口。
content_en:
Someone who appeared out of nowhere was able to overwhelm that god-like man and beat him. However, before everyone had time to eat, they were shocked when both sides started fighting.
To the two parties fighting, those high-rise buildings and various buildings were like piles of sand, breaking into pieces at the first touch.
Hunter could only order that all the Crusaders who could still operate normally should do their best to rescue the citizens affected by the fighting between the two sides!
However, the final result was not ideal, and everyone had no choice but to hide in the nearest shelter.
Because the energy burst out from the fight between the two sides was too huge.
It was okay at first. As long as he wasn't unlucky enough to be hit, it wouldn't be a big problem. The ground behind him couldn't stand at all. The energy of one of them was so powerful that it seemed to be able to melt all the surrounding materials, and the ground was constantly sinking.
Some Crusaders were enveloped by the invisible energy field and turned into ashes in just three to five seconds because they had no time to escape.
Even the Crusaders have their own beliefs. Such a shocking fighting scene makes everyone involuntarily compare the gods they believe in with the two parties fighting.
Of course, there were also many Crusaders who died in the fighting between the two sides.
…
"Okay! The alert has been lifted, everyone, please go out." Crow Su said.
The regional disaster announcement on the AI ​​wristband had just been lifted, and Klaue Su directed everyone to leave the underground shelter. The silent waiting was the most painful.
Rafi Ivelrios took the lead and led the people out of the shelter and into the elevator.
"Ah~ His Highness Raffi!" Sumela exclaimed.
Sumera was one of the first people to reach the ground accompanying Princess Rafite. She stood at the door of the elevator. As soon as she opened the door, she saw the basement in front of her changed.
The originally luxurious basement is now covered with dust and debris, and the entrance door to the basement has disappeared.
It’s not that the door is gone, but that the entire superstructure of the basement is gone.
This question didn't surprise her!
What made Sumela scream was the scene coming in from the basement entrance!
Where is this basement?
Not to mention the core area of ​​Su Mansion, at least within Su Mansion, right?
Outside is the other courtyard of the Su Mansion, and now you can actually see the sky directly! ! !
"Don't worry! Let's go out and take a look first!" Rafi Ivelrios said.
Then Sumela supported Princess Rafite and slowly walked up the stairs. At this time, everyone discovered that there was a thick layer of powder under their feet, which would sink softly if they stepped on it.
It gets thicker as we get to the entrance, and by the time we get to the upper steps, we can no longer see the original stairs.
I don’t know what this is. There shouldn’t be so much sand, right?
…
Everyone lost their voice collectively!
At a glance, only Monsoon College in the distance and a few familiar buildings further away still remain on the land. The rest is only sand, and further away, only the outline of the Black Mountain Mountains can be seen!
If it weren't for Princess Rafite, who had the body of a legendary professional and could clearly see the Monsoon Academy in the distance, she would have thought that she was in a different place now!
All the surrounding man-made buildings and landforms seemed to have been wiped away by an invisible hand, leaving only the fine sand underfoot.
"Please give way, Rafi Ivelious." Zachary Su said.
Claudius Su, Zachary Su and others were blocked by Princess Lafite's group at the exit. Claudius Su was at odds with Princess Lafite and was unwilling to say anything more to her, so Zachary did the talking.
